# Historical Decomposition

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
dates_formatted <- as.yearmon(time(x))
dates_formatted <- dates_formatted[(p+1):length(dates_formatted)]
str(dates_formatted)
colors_shock <- c("purple", "orange", "lightblue", "yellow",  "blue", "red", "green")
names <- c("$Q_{elec}$" ,"$P_{elec}$", "IPI",  "$HICP$", "ECB_rate", "Gas", "Trend")

theta_0 <- matrix(rnorm(10, 0, 1), ncol=2, nrow= length(colors_shock))
irf_response_test <- as.data.frame(theta_0)
irf_response_test$shock <- rep(names, length.out = length(theta_0[,1]))
irf_response_test$shock <- factor(irf_response_test$shock, levels = names)
# fake plot just to construct the correct legend
dates_formatted <- as.yearmon(time(x))
dates_formatted <- dates_formatted[(p+1):length(dates_formatted)]
# Format to shorter labels (e.g., "May 15", "Jun 15", ...)


plot_legend <- ggplot(data =irf_response_test, aes(x=V1, fill = shock))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme( legend.direction = "horizontal")+
scale_fill_manual(
  values = rev(colors_shock),
  labels = TeX(names))
# Légende personnalisée (à ajuster selon vos besoins)
custom_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(plot_legend)
```

La différence qui existe entre ma série et la série reconstruite
correspond à l'approximation de la limite des horizons.
Lorsque pour une Cholesky, on calcule de plus en plus d'horizons,
la différence entre les deux courbes se réduit
En plus, il y avait la dérive intuitée par Giovanni.

```{r}

# Apply the function to the sequence 3:10
results <- lapply(c(1:n) , plot_hd_inflation_glissante_12)

#enlever la légende
results <- lapply(results, function(p) p + theme(legend.position = "none"))


# Arrange the plots in a grid
plots_grid <- do.call("grid.arrange", c(results, nrow = 2))

# Combine the grid with the legend
final_plot <- plot_grid(plots_grid, custom_legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1))

title <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label(TeX('Historical Decomposition'), fontface = 'bold', x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)

# Combine the title and the final plot with legend
final_plot_with_title <- plot_grid(title, final_plot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))

# Display the final plot
print(final_plot_with_title)
```

```{r}
alpha_chosen = 1
n_serie = 4
colors_shock <- rev(c("purple", "yellow",  "blue", "red", "green"))
historical_decomp_matrix <- hd_cholesky[,,]
#ne_hd_compare <- plot_hd(series = n_serie)
alpha_chosen = 0.4

df_chol <- ggplot_build(plot_hd_inflation_glissante_12(series = n_serie))$data[[1]]  %>%
  filter(fill == "green" | fill == "red") %>%
  mutate(
    Method = "Cholesky",
    fill = case_when(
      fill == "green"  ~ "$Q_{elec}$",
      fill == "red" ~ "$P_{elec}$",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )%>%
  filter(!is.na(fill))

historical_decomp_matrix <- historical_decomp_iv_tibo

data1 <- ggplot_build(plot_hd_inflation_glissante_12(series = n_serie))$data 

df1 <- data1[[1]] %>% 
  mutate(
    Method = "IV",
    fill = case_when(
      fill == "green"  ~ "$Q_{elec}$",
      fill == "red" ~ "$P_{elec}$",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # or another fallback label
    )
  )%>%
  filter(!is.na(fill)) 


# 2. Plot separately but still trigger alpha legend
ne_hd_compare_12 <- ggplot() +
  # Cholesky layer (alpha = 1)
  geom_bar(data = df_chol, aes(x = as.Date(x), y = y, fill = fill, alpha = Method),
           stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  
  # IV layer (alpha = 0.4)
  geom_bar(data = df1, aes(x = as.Date(x), y = y, fill = fill, alpha = Method),
           stat = "identity", position = "stack") +

  # 3. Manual alpha scale
  scale_alpha_manual(
    values = c("Cholesky" = 1, "IV" = 0.4),
    name = "Identification"
  ) +

  # 4. Manual fill scale with LaTeX labels
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c( "red", "green"),
    labels = c( expression(P[elec]), expression(Q[elec])),
    name = "Shock"
  ) +

  guides(
    alpha = guide_legend(order = 1),
    fill = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )+
  labs(title = "Comparing HD for HICP",
       x = "Time",
       y = "Contribution") 

inflation_12m = slide_dbl(IV_data_log_diff_esp$HICP_log_diff, sum, .before = 11, .complete = TRUE)
ne_hd_compare_12 <- ne_hd_compare_12 +
    geom_line(aes(x = as.Date(dates_formatted), y = inflation_12m[(p+1):length(inflation_12m)]), color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title=TeX(paste("Historical Decomposition of HICP with 12-month Inflation")) ,
         x="Time", y="Contribution")
ne_hd_compare_12
```
